item.title: Mach Five Tech Partners with Bet Max Action to Power Tournament-Based Sports Gaming Platform
item.description:
×
Strategic Technology Partnership

For Immediate Release

Chicago IL • March 1, 2026. Mach Five Tech today announced a strategic product and platform partnership with Bet Max Action to design, build, and scale a tournament-based sports gaming platform focused on fan engagement, flexibility, and rapid deployment across markets.

The partnership centers on the development of Bet Max Tourney, a full-stack tournament application, and supporting platform infrastructure that enables Bet Max Action to launch, test, and iterate quickly while supporting future integrations with sportsbooks, media partners, and international operators.
